himayah.logo: An open margin bracket enclosing one decisive dot; a quiet lowercase legal wordmark
himayah.architecture: Clause manuscript → obligation margin → exact cited passage → revision history
himayah.interaction: Select a clause, then expose only its obligations and source support
himayah.motion: A narrow margin unfolds; no dramatic approval flourish
himayah.agent: Obligation, severity and evidence remain adjacent to the original clause
himayah.signature: A disputed sentence opens its exact supporting passage
himayah.boundary: Never turn a model opinion into legal certification

iqamah.logo: A tall open doorway in a solid field; centered high-contrast residency lettering
iqamah.architecture: Route passport → requirements register → documents shelf → dated route changes
iqamah.interaction: Compare what a route asks for against documents actually held
iqamah.motion: Page-edge reveals establish progression without implying a government decision
iqamah.agent: Dossier gaps, expiry and verification status are distinct
iqamah.signature: The dossier can show a missing document without an invented eligibility score
iqamah.boundary: Avoid gold badges that resemble government endorsement

istithmar.logo: Two offset investment planes with an ascending cut; compact architectural lowercase
istithmar.architecture: Activity brief → side-by-side jurisdiction columns → cost horizon → scenario provenance
istithmar.interaction: Change horizon and inspect which supplied costs change the ordering
istithmar.motion: Short horizontal shifts connect a changed assumption to its affected column
istithmar.agent: A recommendation is a comparison with its assumptions attached
istithmar.signature: A zero-cost or zero-visa assumption remains an explicit zero
istithmar.boundary: Do not invent current fees or silently favor the cheapest unsupported option

munagasah.philosophy: A bid is an evidence argument
munagasah.logo: Three expanding bid bars cut by a vertical registration rule; numbered monospace masthead
munagasah.architecture: Tender cover → requirement matrix → capability evidence → submission clock
munagasah.interaction: Move from a requirement to supporting capability before drafting prose
munagasah.motion: Crisp sectional reveals follow evidence acquisition, not fictitious completion percentages
munagasah.agent: The team composes a requirement-by-requirement evidence case
munagasah.signature: The procurement channel stays separate from an actual tender pack
munagasah.boundary: A public eSupply page is not a tender and cannot establish bid fit

sahil.logo: One continuous coastal ribbon with an open exit; friendly sentence-case signature
sahil.architecture: Service question → prerequisites path → document request → official channel
sahil.interaction: Reveal one dependency at a time, while letting the resident jump back
sahil.motion: A calm short transition exposes the next prerequisite
sahil.agent: Public guidance explains the dependency before asking for personal documents
sahil.signature: A service requirement links directly to the official source
sahil.boundary: Never imply a DEWA move-in has been submitted

tawteen.logo: Two unequal solid forms held by a shared baseline; split stacked workforce wordmark
tawteen.architecture: Workforce roster → supplied target basis → aggregate result → policy context
tawteen.interaction: Inspect headcounts and basis before interpreting the percentage
tawteen.motion: Aggregation resolves from actual rows, with no decorative growth animation
tawteen.agent: Computed target gaps are tied to the supplied workforce
tawteen.signature: One employee correction changes the recomputed aggregate
tawteen.boundary: Policy context is not an authenticated payroll integration

adl.logo: An interrupted vertical pillar bridged by one horizontal stone; restrained case inscription
adl.architecture: Chronology spine → event evidence → claimed amounts → case export
adl.interaction: Arrange events by supplied dates and distinguish allegations from receipts
adl.motion: The chronology extends vertically as evidence is added
adl.agent: Findings stay anchored to a dated event or a stated claim
adl.signature: An unsupported claimed amount never becomes an established debt
adl.boundary: Do not present a model opinion as an RDC ruling

tawassul.logo: Two crossing ribbons that meet without a star or enclosing badge; asymmetric B2B wordmark
tawassul.architecture: Account letter → need-to-product match → approved-fact drawer → outreach draft
tawassul.interaction: Select a customer need and expose only facts authorized for that account
tawassul.motion: A restrained letter reveal favors reading over spectacle
tawassul.agent: The agent drafts from approved product facts and declared needs
tawassul.signature: A sales claim can be traced back to the approved account material
tawassul.boundary: No fabricated customer research or sent outreach

adab.logo: A bold cut punctuation stroke above a widely tracked editorial wordmark
adab.architecture: Original copy → claim annotations → language alternatives → editorial boundaries
adab.interaction: Read the original beside proposed changes and inspect a specific claim
adab.motion: Precise replacement emphasis, with reduced-motion static highlights
adab.agent: The agent adapts language while preserving factual approval boundaries
adab.signature: A prohibited term points to the exact affected phrase
adab.boundary: Cultural adaptation is not permission to invent product claims

khidmah.emotion: Warmth, fairness and a clear path
khidmah.logo: A soft speech opening formed from two solid quarters; welcoming compact care lettering
khidmah.architecture: Customer situation → policy basis → amount check → resolution explanation
khidmah.interaction: Start with the reason, then show why a policy applies
khidmah.motion: Gentle expansion communicates what the agent needs next
khidmah.agent: A resolution distinguishes customer report, merchant policy and calculation
khidmah.signature: A zero refund limit is respected instead of replaced by a default
khidmah.boundary: Do not claim a refund transaction occurred

jomrok.logo: A modular freight block with an unmistakable diagonal customs cut; compressed manifest label
jomrok.architecture: Manifest header → required fields register → declared valuation → duty assumptions
jomrok.interaction: Inspect omissions before arithmetic, keeping supplied rates visible
jomrok.motion: Fast mechanical reveals reflect document checks, never simulated clearance
jomrok.agent: The agent checks shipment completeness and declared valuation
jomrok.signature: A missing field is located in the manifest instead of buried in prose
jomrok.boundary: No live customs classification or border clearance claim

khibrat.logo: Three offset competency tiles with one connecting notch; measured skills wordmark
khibrat.architecture: Role rubric → evidence matrix → unmatched criteria → interview prompts
khibrat.interaction: Open a criterion and inspect the exact candidate evidence attached
khibrat.motion: Focus moves between criterion and evidence rather than celebrating a score
khibrat.agent: The agent explains evidence gaps against the supplied role rubric
khibrat.boundary: Avoid claims of fair hiring certification or unapproved applicant inference

majlis.logo: A low gathering arc above a single seat; generous host-like literary masthead
majlis.architecture: Invitation → onboarding book → protocol notes → arrival agenda
majlis.interaction: Explore the welcome book at the executive’s pace
majlis.motion: Measured page-like reveals encourage unhurried reading
majlis.agent: The agent orders supplied onboarding tasks by dependencies
majlis.signature: A protocol note stays connected to its source or supplied task
majlis.boundary: No invented company policies or completed onboarding actions

rafiq.logo: An off-center orbit cut by a small daylight wedge; compact humanist companion wordmark
rafiq.architecture: Device-time dial → available day → commitments timeline → task placement
rafiq.interaction: See actual device time and arrange tasks within supplied boundaries
rafiq.motion: Clock updates are quiet; scheduling changes emphasize displacement
rafiq.agent: The agent places tasks around actual supplied commitments
rafiq.signature: A genuine open interval is visible without inventing calendar access
rafiq.boundary: Device time is not a connected calendar or booked appointment

sawm.philosophy: A rhythm of intention and rest
sawm.logo: A single almond-shaped pause between asymmetric dusk curves; hushed small literary signature
sawm.architecture: Daily intention → protected rest → commitments → gentler plan
sawm.interaction: Prioritize boundaries and rest rather than a productivity score
sawm.motion: Slow reveals stop immediately under reduced motion
sawm.agent: The agent respects user-entered day boundaries and work constraints
sawm.signature: Rest remains protected even when the task list cannot all fit
sawm.boundary: No medical fasting advice or fabricated prayer timings

mizan.logo: A solid offset counterweight balanced by an open ledger line; emphatic financial monogram
mizan.architecture: Financial position → budgets panes → verified transactions → values context
mizan.interaction: Separate recorded arithmetic from the interpretation of Islamic-finance guidance
mizan.motion: Numeric changes resolve directly; no wealth-growth celebration
mizan.agent: The agent reconciles supplied records before offering source-linked context
mizan.signature: A disputed transaction can be excluded without changing its original record
mizan.boundary: No bank access, investment promise or religious certification

thawg.logo: A sculpted wedge on a fine plate line; oversized dining-publication lettering
thawg.architecture: Dining edit → needs filter → candidate shortlist → food safety notes
thawg.interaction: Build a shortlist from actual supplied options and inspect exclusions
thawg.motion: Measured editorial reveals; no fake live availability shimmer
thawg.agent: The agent filters budget, party size and required tags visibly
thawg.signature: An allergen question becomes a concrete verification prompt
thawg.boundary: A shortlist is not a halal certificate or a reservation

manzil.philosophy: The household deserves a readable book
manzil.logo: An open ledger roof with a warm offset window; intimate handwritten-feeling book title
manzil.architecture: Household book → receipt intake → duplicate register → spending categories
manzil.interaction: Bring receipts into the ledger, flag duplicates, then reconcile
manzil.motion: Receipt insertion unfolds from its point of entry
manzil.agent: The agent separates duplicate, unverified and counted receipts
manzil.signature: A repeated identifier is shown before it can inflate totals
manzil.boundary: VAT overview does not establish the recoverability of a household receipt

gurbah.philosophy: A move is a dependency map
gurbah.logo: A stepping route that becomes an open arrival arch; tall map-like relocation signature
gurbah.architecture: Before-arrival map → dependency list → service context → settled tasks
gurbah.interaction: Follow prerequisites while retaining the option to explore ahead
gurbah.motion: Progressive path reveals reflect recorded dependencies only
gurbah.agent: The agent orders supplied relocation tasks and highlights blockers
gurbah.signature: A dependent task points back to what must happen first
gurbah.boundary: No invented immigration status or external service completion

amanah-eco.philosophy: Compare periods before calling it savings
amanah-eco.logo: Two broad flowing resource bands around a narrow measurement gap; observatory-style wordmark
amanah-eco.architecture: Resource observatory → period comparison → measurement basis → conservation reading
amanah-eco.interaction: Enter period lengths alongside readings so comparisons stay normalized
amanah-eco.motion: A comparison changes only when actual measurements change
amanah-eco.agent: The agent distinguishes measured rate changes from unexplained causes
amanah-eco.signature: A lower total over fewer days cannot masquerade as savings
amanah-eco.boundary: No invented meter connection, tariff, emissions or weather adjustment

nafas.logo: An airy open oval formed by two unequal strokes; softly spaced lowercase breath wordmark
nafas.architecture: Breathing pause → preferred practices → gentle routine → evidence reading
nafas.interaction: Start and stop a local pacing timer without an account
nafas.motion: Breath pacing honors reduced motion and stops in the background
nafas.agent: The agent suggests a bounded routine from stated preferences
nafas.signature: The breathing pause works locally without pretending to measure health
nafas.boundary: No diagnosis or claim that the pacing pattern is a clinical protocol

tadweer.philosophy: Give a material its next route
tadweer.logo: A folded material strip with one visible return edge, without recycling-arrow cliché
tadweer.architecture: Material selection → hazardous status → supplied routes → handling context
tadweer.interaction: Identify material and handling constraints before ranking routes
tadweer.motion: A folded edge opens to explain the selected route
tadweer.agent: The agent uses actual supplied route capabilities and hazard constraints
tadweer.signature: A hazardous item cannot quietly enter an ordinary collection route
tadweer.boundary: No booked pickup or fabricated local collection capacity

turath.logo: A fragmented archaeological rubbing with one restored accent; scholarly archive wordmark
turath.architecture: Topic index → source folios → learning trail → citations
turath.interaction: Choose a topic and follow only the sources actually present
turath.motion: Folio reveals favor attentive reading rather than artificial age effects
turath.agent: The agent teaches with distinguishable source-backed statements
turath.signature: A topic without supporting material remains an open research question
turath.boundary: No invented heritage facts or copied museum imagery

himam.logo: A continuous accessible turn with wide open negative space; exceptionally readable access signature
himam.architecture: Requirements first → barrier evidence → route alternatives → verification gaps
himam.interaction: Inspect known barriers and missing evidence before choosing a route
himam.motion: Immediate focus transitions; no motion needed to understand the route
himam.agent: The agent matches supplied access needs to documented route constraints
himam.signature: An unknown barrier stays unknown instead of becoming an accessible route
himam.boundary: No live navigation, transport booking or safety guarantee

hisad.philosophy: Food rescue is a clock and a match
hisad.logo: A cut grain seed joining two unequal hands through negative space; bold rescue-dispatch lettering
hisad.architecture: Handling checkpoint → available lot → recipient capacities → dispatch reasoning
hisad.interaction: Match actual quantity, dates and recipient constraints before proposing allocation
hisad.motion: Decisive status changes follow verified records, never a fake countdown
hisad.agent: The agent exposes handling and recipient evidence before a rescue proposal
hisad.signature: An unsupported handling condition prevents a confident allocation
hisad.boundary: No invented donation, delivery receipt or food-safety certification
